hindi: हे देव सविता, यज्ञ को प्रेरित करो, यज्ञपति को सौभाग्य के लिए प्रेरित करो। दिव्य गन्धर्व, जो अभिप्राय को शुद्ध करने वाला है, हमारे अभिप्राय को शुद्ध करे; वाचस्पति हमारे बल को स्वादिष्ट करे। स्वाहा।
english: O god Savitṛ, impel the sacrifice, impel the lord of the sacrifice, for good fortune. May the divine Gandharva, purifier of intent, purify our intent; may Vācaspati make our strength sweet. Svāhā.
notes: Obscure: ketu / keta (rendered 'intent', literally a sign, ray or perception) and bhagāya (taken as 'good fortune'; it could also name Bhaga). Gandharva and Vācaspati are named in the line; no further identity added.

hindi: तुझे, जो दृढ़ता से बैठता है, मनुष्यों में बैठता है, मन में बैठता है, तू उपयाम से ग्रहण किया गया है; इन्द्र के लिए प्रिय तुझे मैं ग्रहण करता हूँ; यह तेरा आसन है; इन्द्र के लिए अत्यन्त प्रिय तुझे। तुझे, जो जलों में बैठता है, घी में बैठता है, आकाश में बैठता है, तू उपयाम से ग्रहण किया गया है; इन्द्र के लिए प्रिय तुझे मैं ग्रहण करता हूँ; यह तेरा आसन है; इन्द्र के लिए अत्यन्त प्रिय तुझे। तुझे, जो पृथ्वी पर बैठता है, अन्तरिक्ष में बैठता है, द्युलोक में बैठता है, देवों में बैठता है, स्वर्ग में बैठता है, तू उपयाम से ग्रहण किया गया है; इन्द्र के लिए प्रिय तुझे मैं ग्रहण करता हूँ; यह तेरा आसन है; इन्द्र के लिए अत्यन्त प्रिय तुझे।
english: You who sit firm, who sit among men, who sit in the mind: you are taken with the upayāma. For Indra I take you, the pleasing one; this is your seat; for Indra, you the most pleasing. You who sit in the waters, who sit in ghee, who sit in the sky: you are taken with the upayāma. For Indra I take you, the pleasing one; this is your seat; for Indra, you the most pleasing. You who sit on the earth, who sit in the air, who sit in the sky, who sit among the gods, who sit in heaven: you are taken with the upayāma. For Indra I take you, the pleasing one; this is your seat; for Indra, you the most pleasing.
notes: Three repeated formulas, each addressed to the offering taken up ('you'). upayāma is kept untranslated (an implement or support; sense uncertain). yoni rendered 'seat' (literally womb). The third line has a doubled space after juṣṭaṃ in the source; kept inside the src of the previous token. Transliteration marks ṷ, ḙ in src are artefacts of accent marks, not variants.

hindi: जलों का रस, जो उच्च बल वाला है, सूर्य में स्थित और एकत्र किया हुआ है; जलों के रस का जो रस है, तुम्हारे उस उत्तम को मैं ग्रहण करता हूँ; तू उपयाम से ग्रहण किया गया है; इन्द्र के लिए प्रिय तुझे मैं ग्रहण करता हूँ; यह तेरा आसन है; इन्द्र के लिए अत्यन्त प्रिय तुझे।
english: The essence of the waters, of high vigour, being in the sun, gathered together; the essence that is the essence of the waters, that best one of yours I take. You are taken with the upayāma. For Indra I take you, the pleasing one; this is your seat; for Indra, you the most pleasing.

hindi: हे ग्रहो, जिनकी आहुति बल है, प्रेरित जन के लिए मति की ओर जाते हुए; उन बस्ती में प्रिय तुम्हारा मैंने अन्न और बल एकत्र कर लिया। तू उपयाम से ग्रहण किया गया है; इन्द्र के लिए प्रिय तुझे मैं ग्रहण करता हूँ; यह तेरा आसन है; इन्द्र के लिए अत्यन्त प्रिय तुझे। तुम दोनों मिलाने वाले हो, मुझे कल्याण से मिलाओ; तुम दोनों अलग करने वाले हो, मुझे पाप से अलग करो।
english: O grahas, whose offerings are strength, going (or enjoying) for the inspired one, a reflection. Of those, dear in the settlement, of you, I have gathered food and strength. You are taken with the upayāma. For Indra I take you, the pleasing one; this is your seat; for Indra, you the most pleasing. You two are joiners: join me with the good; you two are separators: separate me from evil.
notes: The first part (grahā ūrjāhutayo vyanto viprāya matim; teṣāṃ viśipriyāṇāṃ) is obscure: ūrjāhutayaḥ, vyantaḥ and viśipriyāṇām are uncertain, and the syntax between the two halves is unclear, so the first sentence is a literal rendering only. 'grahāḥ' is left as 'grahas'; the line does not explain it. sampṛcau/vipṛcau are duals ('you two'). The printed sampṛcaṷ / vipṛcaṷ read sampṛcau / vipṛcau (ṷ is the accented u of au; not a misprint).

hindi: तू इन्द्र का वज्र है, बल को जीतने वाला; तेरे द्वारा यह बल को जीते। बल की प्रेरणा में हम वाणी से महान माता अदिति को नाम से पुकारते हैं, जिसमें यह सारा भुवन प्रविष्ट हुआ है; उसमें देव सविता हमारे लिए धर्म को प्रेरित करे।
english: You are Indra's thunderbolt, a winner of strength; by you may this one win strength. Now, in the impulse of strength, we call by name with speech the great mother Aditi, in whom this whole world has entered; in her may the god Savitṛ impel dharma for us.
notes: 'set' is read as an optative or subjunctive of √sā/√san 'may he win', but the form is uncertain. 'yasyām ... tasyām' relates to Aditi. 'dharma' (neuter, 'support, order') is kept as dharma; 'naḥ' could also be read 'our'. Who 'this one' (ayam) is is not stated in the line.

english: Within the waters is immortality, in the waters a remedy; and in the praises of the waters, O horses, become strong ones. O divine waters, the wave of yours that rushes forward, crested, a winner of strength: by that may this one win strength.
notes: 'amṛtam' is rendered 'immortality' (it can also mean the immortal drink). 'pratūrtiḥ' is taken as an adjective of ūrmiḥ. 'vājinaḥ' read as predicate 'strong'.

english: Be swift as the wind, O strong one, while you are being yoked; be like Indra's right-hand one (or skilful one), and prosper with splendour. May the Maruts, all-knowing, yoke you; may Tvaṣṭṛ place speed in your feet.

english: The speed that is placed in you, O strong one, in secret, that which is entrusted to the hawk and moved in the wind: by that, O strong one, be strong for us, a winner of strength by strength, and one who brings through in the contest. O strong ones, winners of strength, about to run for strength, smell Bṛhaspati's share.

english: Let your vigour be in us, in us manliness and will; let your splendours be in us. Homage to the mother Earth, homage to the mother Earth. This is your ruler; you are the controller, the restrainer; you are firm, the supporter. You for cultivation, you for security, you for wealth, you for nourishment.
notes: 'asme' (in us / to us) and the sense of 'vaḥ' (your) are tentative. 'iyaṃ te rāṭ': 'this' is not identified in the line; 'rāṭ' feminine, rendered 'ruler'. 'pṛthivyā iyam' is pṛthivyai + iyam (ai before vowel gives ā). The addressee of 'you' in the last part is not stated.

hindi: बल की प्रेरणा ने पहले इस राजा सोम को ओषधियों में और जलों में उत्पन्न किया। वे हमारे लिए मधुर हों; हम पुरोहित राष्ट्र में जागरूक रहें। स्वाहा।
english: The impulse of strength has first brought forth this king Soma, in the plants, in the waters. May they be honeyed for us; may we, the purohitas (placed in front), be wakeful in the kingdom. Svāhā.
notes: 'suṣuve' (√sū) could be 'has brought forth/impelled' or 'was pressed'; read as an active sense. 'tāḥ' is taken to refer back to the plants and waters. 'purohitāḥ' ('placed in front', family priests) could modify 'we' or describe the priests themselves.

english: The impulse of strength, the sovereign, has resorted to this one, to the sky and to all these worlds. Knowing, he makes the unwilling one give; may he bestow on us wealth rich in all heroes. Svāhā.
notes: 'imām' is a feminine accusative 'this (one)'; the line does not say what it refers to (earth is a likely guess but not stated). 'samrāṭ' is taken with the impulse (sovereign). 'saḥ' (he) is taken as the same sovereign.

hindi: हे निर्ऋति, यह तेरा भाग है; उसका सेवन कर। स्वाहा। अग्नि के नेतृत्व वाले, आगे बैठने वाले देवों के लिए स्वाहा। यम के नेतृत्व वाले, दक्षिण में बैठने वाले देवों के लिए स्वाहा। विश्वेदेवों के नेतृत्व वाले, पीछे बैठने वाले देवों के लिए स्वाहा। मित्र और वरुण के या मरुतों के नेतृत्व वाले, उत्तर में बैठने वाले देवों के लिए स्वाहा। सोम के नेतृत्व वाले, ऊपर बैठने वाले, सेवा करने वाले देवों के लिए स्वाहा।
english: This is your share, O Nirṛti; enjoy it. Svāhā. To the gods led by Agni, who sit in front, svāhā. To the gods led by Yama, who sit on the south, svāhā. To the gods led by the Viśvedevas, who sit behind, svāhā. To the gods led by Mitra and Varuṇa, or led by the Maruts, who sit on the north, svāhā. To the gods led by Soma, who sit above, the homage-paying, svāhā.
notes: Obscure: duvasvadbhyaḥ ('paying homage / worshipful', uncertain). 'sadbhyaḥ' is the dative plural of sad ('sitting'); netrebhyaḥ = 'having X as leader'. 'marunnetrebhyaḥ' = marut-netrebhyaḥ with regular nasal sandhi. 'pura̱ḥ sadbhyaḥ' is two tokens in the source (puraḥ, sadbhyaḥ). Double spaces in the source after 'sadbhyaḥ' are inside src.

hindi: हे देवो, इस शत्रुरहित को महान क्षात्र बल के लिए, महान श्रेष्ठता के लिए, महान जनराज्य के लिए और इन्द्र के पराक्रम के लिए प्रेरित करो। इसे, अमुक के पुत्र को, अमुकी के पुत्र को, इस जन के लिए। हे उधर वालो, यह तुम्हारा राजा है; सोम हम ब्राह्मणों का राजा है।
english: O gods, impel this one, without rival, for great ruling power, for great pre-eminence, for great lordship over the people, for the vigour of Indra. This one, the son of so-and-so (m.), the son of so-and-so (f.), for this clan. This is your king, O you yonder; Soma is the king of us brāhmaṇas.
notes: 'amuṣya ... amuṣyai' are placeholders (the father's and mother's names) to be spoken. 'vo'mī' is read vaḥ + amī ('your, you yonder'), uncertain. 'asyai viśe' = for this clan (people). The two sentences of line 2 have no governing verb of their own; 'impel this one ...' of line 1 carries over.
lines_deva: इ॒मं दे॑वा असप॒त्नᳪ सु॑वध्वं मह॒ते क्ष॒त्राय॑ मह॒ते ज्यैष्ठ्या॑य मह॒ते जान॑राज्या॒येन्द्र॑स्येन्द्रि॒याय॑
इ॒मम॒मुष्य॑ पु॒त्रम॒मुष्यै॑ पु॒त्रम॒स्यै वि॒श ए॒ष वो॑ऽमी॒ राजा॒ सोमो॒ऽस्माकं॑ ब्राह्म॒णाना॒ᳪ राजा॑
